description: Opt-in update checks (spec §7). Only the brain host may check, download and install: it is the window that owns the config toggle, the 24h clock and the pause+persist handoff. The settings window asks for a check by event and never touches the updater plugin itself, so a compromised settings page cannot start a download; overlay webviews are excluded entirely. `process:allow-restart` (not `process:default`) — the app is relaunched after an install, never asked to exit.
